recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.

recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He teaches occult symbolism and tarot on his YouTube channel, ranging across the Major Arcana, the esoteric Enneagram, mythology and archetype, mystic linguistics, and the symbolism hidden in popular film. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.
recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Name: Gabe (Slick Dissident)
recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Role: Co-host of Vibe Rant; teacher of occult symbolism & tarot

recOq9xeYHvqku9Dl.Bio: LC King is a recurring InnerVerse "Vibe Rant" panelist who brings a mechanical/engineering background to discussions of electric-universe theory, cavitation technology, and the intersections of astrology and alchemy.
recOq9xeYHvqku9Dl.Name: LC King

reckIvJxU4wRhybxA.Bio: Mario Garza is the artist and researcher behind Symbolic Studies, a project sharing symbolic insights on the zodiac, mythology, folklore and world religions, with astrology as its foundation. A lifelong artist who has worked as an art director and graphic designer for nearly 25 years, he runs Symbolic Studies from the Pacific Northwest alongside his wife Michelle, who co-hosts the podcast with him. His work traces syncretic threads across tarot, occultism and comparative religion, including the argument that the major deities of antiquity were originally polar gods before a solar model was laid over them. He also offers symbolic birth chart and tarot readings, private lessons and freelance design.
reckIvJxU4wRhybxA.Name: Mario Garza

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Polar Symbolism and the Center of the World", "body": "One panelist shared a book on polar symbolism that argued communities once organized themselves around a central axis, and that losing the physical axis point sent a community into decline. The same panelist read a passage calling the cosmic pole the source of legitimate law, with the scepter and measuring rod as its images. Others added the Roman boundary god Terminus, the omphalos, London's stone and the navel as the body's center, and one speaker noted such centers are typically a mound, stone, tree or pillar. One speaker suggested that anyone could build a personal cosmic pillar in the heart or home."}, {"title": "Memory Palaces and the Zodiac as Record", "body": "Panelists compared memory palaces to the astral temple used in shamanic journey work, which one panelist described building with four directions and an altar in each. Gabe noted that the Hannibal Lecter stories made mind palaces central to the character, and said the stories vilified that skill. One panelist proposed that memory lives in a personal ether, while another wondered whether the zodiac itself worked as a shared mind palace, a spinning record tied to the Akashic record. A speaker added that calendars and seasonal rituals refreshed those stored memories."}, {"title": "Southern Skies, Calendars and Sky Questions", "body": "LC King described a 364 day calendar set to the stars, saying it let a farmer repeat the same task on the same day each year, and he said the seasons ran reversed in Australia while the signs stayed the same. Answering chat questions relayed by a host, he said he could not see Polaris from where he lived, and later said he was far south in Victoria, could not see Ursa Major or Minor, but could see Orion's belt. One panelist described a blue sky stone said to be rich in oxygen as a possible piece of the firmament."}, {"title": "Taurus Bulls, Sacrifice and the Number Five", "body": "Mario said he was researching Taurus and had released a video on bull and cow myths, including the minotaur and the golden calf. Panelists then traded ideas about sacrifice, with one reading the setting sign as the sign that dies each season and another suggesting that sacrifice stories were metaphors for a sign going into the sun. One panelist described Auriga as a pentagram holding a goat and tied the number five to the Hierophant card, the Roman numeral V and the month of May. Another floated a link between the letters A U, gold, Taurus and Australia."}, {"title": "Twins, Number Symbolism and Moon Knight", "body": "The panel turned to Gemini twins, with one panelist citing Babylonian brick making, the Sun card and Romulus and Remus, and others adding Cain and Abel and Castor and Pollux. One panelist argued that nature multiplies rather than divides, so reading two as a split reflected a lost mystical view of number. Another speaker described a placenta theory in which the afterbirth acts as a divine twin. Gabe said he had released a stream of consciousness video on Moon Knight, and panelists read its bathroom, mirror and moon imagery symbolically."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: LC King, Mario Garza and Slick Dissident combine their symbolic superpowers tonight! As we weave our shared knowledge on the variety of topics we've been independently studying, join us for an exploration of the occult wonders of our world and electrify your education of the mystic arts.
